source.content: public class MockResponse implements HttpCalloutMock { private String body; private Integer statusCode; public MockResponse(String body, Integer statusCode) { this.body = body; this.statusCode = statusCode; } public HttpResponse respond(HttpRequest req) { HttpResponse res = new HttpResponse(); if (body != null) { res.setBody(body); } if (statusCode != null) { res.setStatusCode(statusCode); } return res; } }

@isTest private class HttpCalloutEdgesFixtureTest { @isTest static void mockEdges() { Test.setMock('HttpCalloutMock', new MockResponse('mock-body', 207)); HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); System.assertEquals(10000, req.getTimeout()); req.setEndpoint('callout:NamedCredential/resource'); req.setMethod('post'); System.assertEquals('POST', req.getMethod()); req.setHeader('X-Test', 'first'); req.setHeader('x-test', 'second'); System.assertEquals('second', req.getHeader('X-TEST')); System.assertEquals(null, req.getHeader('missing')); req.setTimeout(120000); System.assertEquals(120000, req.getTimeout()); req.setBodyAsBlob(Blob.valueOf('request-body')); System.assertEquals('request-body', req.getBody()); System.assertEquals('726571756573742d626f6479', EncodingUtil.convertToHex(req.getBodyAsBlob())); Http h = new Http(); HttpResponse res = h.send(req); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getCallouts()); System.assertEquals(207, res.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('mock-body', res.getBody()); res.setStatus('Multi-Status'); res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/plain'); System.assertEquals('Multi-Status', res.getStatus()); System.assertEquals('text/plain', res.getHeader('content-type')); res.setBodyAsBlob(Blob.valueOf('response-body')); System.assertEquals('response-body', res.getBody()); System.assertEquals('726573706f6e73652d626f6479', EncodingUtil.convertToHex(res.getBodyAsBlob())); } }
